result.reason: The added clause largely tracks the preferred position, including mutuality, the greater-of cap, consequential-damages exclusion, and all specified carve-outs. However, it measures fees during the 12 months preceding the event giving rise to the claim rather than the claim itself, which can materially alter the cap, and it excludes only payment obligations under Sections 3 and 4.2 rather than all Customer payment obligations. The insertion otherwise leaves unrelated language unchanged and is professionally structured.
